description: This file contains functions related to dragging and moving elements within a drawing application, including handling selected elements, calculating offsets, and updating element positions.

methods.name: dragSelectedElements
methods.description: Handles dragging of selected elements, updating their positions, and managing bindings and frames.

methods.name: getDragOffsetXY
methods.description: Calculates the offset between the current position and the common bounds of selected elements.

methods.name: dragNewElement
methods.description: Handles the creation and resizing of a new element during drag operations, maintaining aspect ratio and position.
